summary: An editorial microsite built as 'A canon. A typeface. An alphabet.': the home page is a grey A–Z glossary of 26 design terms (Anatomy … Zone), each opening an essay subpage with readings set in GT Canon; the actual specimen (System, Design, Platform, Specs, Colophon) lives in a black 'Information' panel that slides in from the right, and a 'Typewriter' toolbar turns the screen into a full-page tester. The capture scrolled the closed panel, so every crop shows the glossary page; panel components are read from HTML only.

instances.look: White page, tiny centred title 'A CANON. A TYPEFACE. AN ALPHABET.', then two centred columns of 13 grey uppercase serif words each (ANATOMY, BALANCE, CONTRAST … ZONE), closing line 'FROM A, AS IN Anatomy TO Z, AS IN Zone.' with italics; a black A–Z letter rail on the left edge, black pills '● GT CANON' top-left and 'TRY/BUY | INFORMATION' top-right, 'Aa| TYPEWRITER' tab bottom-left
instances.feel: Quiet, bookish, like a table of contents
instances.ux: Each word (and each rail letter) links to an essay subpage /articles/<term>; an Editor's Note fades in before the word list; 'Information' slides in the specimen panel; 'Typewriter' opens the tester
instances.learn: Make the home page a glossary: 26 terms from A to Z set as a typeset index give the typeface an alphabet-shaped table of contents and a reason to come back

reconstruction.layout: Full viewport, white; two word columns centred at ~26% and ~74% of the width, 13 rows each at ~47px pitch, vertically centred; title 12px at top centre (y≈10px), sign-off 14px at bottom centre; 32px black left rail with A–Z at ~3.3svh spacing; nav pills 32px tall at the corners
reconstruction.typography: Words GT Canon Display (opsz 60, wght 300) ~46px uppercase, leading 1.0, grey #7b7b7b; title and sign-off GT Canon ~12–14px uppercase with italic term names; rail letters 12px white; UI pills GT Canon Mono 14px uppercase white on black
reconstruction.behaviour: Short loader (spinning dot) then the Editor's Note paragraph, then the word index; hover greys links (text-secondary); rail collapses/expands on click (aria 'Toggle article list')
reconstruction.content: 26 design terms; Editor's Note by Patrick Savolainen explaining the L/M/S (term / aesthetics / type design) structure
reconstruction.html: aside[aria-label='Article navigation'] > nav (A–Z links to /articles/*); nav top with a[aria-label='Try or buy…'] and button[data-id=infoBtn]

instances.look: Panel 'Preface' (HTML only): 'GT CANON' at ~198px, '…is neither historical nor futuristic. The' at ~124px, then body text wrapping around a floated mono column with a 'Typeface Specimen' contents list (I Preface … VI Colophon) and a ring of 'Aa Bb … Zz' links labelled 'Parallel Reader', followed by 'What is a canon? instances.ux: Every block of the panel sits in a frame tagged L, M or S (the optical size used); the Aa–Zz ring rotates with scroll (--scroll-rot) and links to the 26 essays; contents items jump to panel sections
instances.learn: Tag each text frame with the optical size it is set in (L / M / S): the layout teaches the opsz axis while you read

reconstruction.layout: Panel 1240px wide (100vw − 200px), 8-col panel-grid; frames with a small corner indicator letter; float-left mono column 33cqw with shape-outside so the M paragraph wraps around it; circle of 26 links laid out by --i around a square

reconstruction.behaviour: Ring rotation bound to panel scroll; panel slides in over 500ms (ease-snap) when 'Information' is clicked

instances.look: 'Aa| Typewriter' tab (visible bottom-left in this crop) opens a black bottom toolbar of 7 columns (Subfamily Small/Medium/Large/Mono radios, Style Regular/Italic, draggable Optical Size, Width and Weight tracks with value + name, Metrics sliders for size px / leading % / tracking em, Features toggles Small Caps / Tabular Fig. / Oldstyle Fig.) over a full-screen white page with one editable line 'The letter hardens into ideology.' at 150px

instances.ux: Type anywhere on the white page; toolbar values update the line live; not tied to a block, attached here because the launcher shows in the crop
instances.learn: A full-screen blank page with a single quote from the essays turns the tester into a writing surface rather than a widget

reconstruction.layout: Fixed overlay inset 0, white; contenteditable centred text full width; toolbar fixed at the bottom-left under a tab (w-28 button), grid of 7 control columns, black, 8px padding
reconstruction.typography: Sample GT Canon 150px, leading 100%, grey #7b7b7b, opsz 60 wdth 100 wght 400 by default; controls GT Canon Mono 11px uppercase, value labels 9px
reconstruction.behaviour: Radios swap subfamily (opsz preset or Mono) and italic; custom drag tracks set opsz, wdth (shows 'Normal'), wght (shows 'Regular'); ranges: size 8–200px, leading 100–200%, tracking −0.05–0.05em; toggles set font-variant-caps small-caps, tnum, onum
reconstruction.content: 'The letter hardens into ideology.' (a line from the essays)
reconstruction.html: fieldset radios name=ui-radio-v-0-0 (small|medium|large|mono), ui-radio-v-0-1 (regular|italic); input[type=range]#ui-range-v-0-2/3/4; input[type=checkbox].toggle-input ×3; div[contenteditable].textbox style font-variation-settings

instances.look: Panel 'Design' (HTML only): heading at ~186px, an M-frame paragraph 'LETTERFORMS, PROPORTION, RHYTHM — we consider GT Canon a new reference point for serif typefaces…', then a Display-size quote from Pascal's Pensées tagged '(D) Display · Section I, Fragment 32'
instances.learn: Pair the design rationale with a canonical literary quote set at display size: the quote proves the claim of a 'canon'

instances.look: Numbered figures (HTML only): pill tags 'FIG. 1' … 'FIG. 9', each with a serif title (Vertical/Horizontal Proportions, Digital Shaping, Special Details, Optical Sizes, Widths, Weights, Slant Angle, Italic Design, Mono proportions) and a short mono caption beside a large Lottie line drawing of glyphs with guides

reconstruction.behaviour: Scroll position selects the active figure (opacity 1 vs 0.5) and plays its Lottie; drawings animate guides and outlines
reconstruction.content: Real design notes: large x-height matching GT Standard, faint diagonal axis, 20° italic angle, optically adjusted weights (Condensed Black lighter than Expanded Black), mono based on Text size

instances.variantDefinition: Two typefaces (or versions) set on the same sample and compared by a divider that follows the pointer (clip-path wipe), or side by side under one pointer-driven pad that sets both at once.
instances.look: Panel 'Platform' (HTML only): the GT Standard pairing shown three ways: an overlaid drawing split by a vertical line that follows the cursor; a 2D field with GT Standard on the left and GT Canon on the right setting the same 5-line quote, axis labels LIGHT/HEAVY (vertical) and CONDENSED/EXPANDED (horizontal) and crosshair lines; then a sticky row of L / M / S frames with the same essay paragraph in serif and sans at matching optical sizes
instances.ux: Move the pointer: horizontally it wipes between the two drawings (cursor ew-resize); in the 2D field x sets wdth 37→150 and y sets wght 300→900 on both texts at once
instances.learn: Drive both families from one pointer so the visitor sees they share widths, weights and metrics: the pairing argument becomes a gesture

reconstruction.layout: Wipe: full panel width, aspect 1.804:1, two absolutely stacked SVGs clipped by polygon at --mouse-x, 1px divider. Field: aspect 1200:501, two equal columns, labels at 5cqw insets, 1px crosshair lines at --mouse-x / --mouse-y. Then a 200svh section with a sticky 3-col grid of L (3.25cqw text), M (~0.875cqw) and S frames
reconstruction.typography: Quote at 2.25cqw (~28px) leading 1.25, GT Standard (font-sans) vs GT Canon (font-serif) at opsz 60, starting wdth 37 wght 300; labels Mono 11px uppercase; L/M/S samples at opsz 60/18/small
reconstruction.behaviour: pointermove updates --mouse-x/--mouse-y; clip-path polygon uses --mouse-x; field maps x→--font-wdth, y→--font-wght on both columns
reconstruction.content: 'Display is about the charge of presence, the weight of saying: this is what matters, at least for now.'; 'To speak of a canon in typography is to invoke a double tension…'
reconstruction.assets: Two SVG glyph drawings for the wipe
reconstruction.html: div.cursor-ew-resize[style=--mouse-x] > div.absolute[style=clip-path: polygon(0 0, var(--mouse-x) 0 …)] ×2 + divider; .grid-cols-2 children with style --font-wdth / --font-wght
